description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery, sourced from Spot 5 with 2.5-metre resolution (1/2/3 band combination), depicting the Araslövssjöområdet Natura 2000 site in Sweden on 2011-06-28. The image displays a diverse landscape: densely vegetated areas, including forests and healthy crops, are represented in deep red; various agricultural fields appear in shades of lighter red, pink, and light green/blue; and a distinct, meandering river is rendered in bright turquoise/cyan blue, with white lines tracing its banks. Additional white lines mark field boundaries and paths across the landscape. In the top-left corner, a small settlement or scattered buildings with associated vegetation are visible as light-coloured structures with red patches. The image provides visual context for land cover/land use (LCLU) and wetland interpretation rules. Credit: CNES 2011©, Distribution Air.
